files.note: Auth-fence defect (BUG-AUTH-FENCE-HANDOVER-20261017): the kernel authentication gate is itself a route on /api and webServer matches the LONGEST prefix first, so mounting /api/dsh-files/* silently bypasses it — register() adds no fence of its own. Every route (the 4 JSON endpoints plus the /dsh-files/static/ preview prefix) now asks the kernel connection.requestRejection() before doing any work, and FAILS CLOSED (503) when that service is unreachable instead of letting the request through.
General-settings collapser: real rows are the slot wrapper children, not the wrapper itself (the whole page used to be hidden as a single "advanced" row).

Drops the 价格设置 settings section and its now-unreachable implementation: its balancePrices/balanceModels/refreshBalance bridge is retired by ADR 0006, so the section could only ever render a misleading "桥接不可用" error. The composer dock is unchanged.
Update-notice button contrast: pin light values (outline 1.10:1 -> 3.11:1, label 1.06:1 -> 4.95:1) on the dark glass card.
